fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-05-24 (morning, 10:50): The purse of the complainant with cash and cards was allegedly lifted while queueing at Kurinji Puram Railway Station Road in Coimbatore. Contact details given by the complainant, Rakesh Anand, include the number 9000000340. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the victim was boarding a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, CCTV, morning, photograph, railway station road
